result.title: DCR-TSF: Dual-Level Compositional Reasoning with Triadic Spherical Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
result.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 14 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
result.summary: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that reflects an intended textual modification while maintaining semantic consistency with a reference image. Existing training-free ZS-CIR methods typically rely on fine-grained generated target descriptions, which often overemphasize reference-specific visual details and lead to appearance-biased retrieval. Moreover, since these descriptions are generated through multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the direct influence of the original image-text query can be weakened in the final retrieval representation. In this paper, we propose DCR-TSF, a training-free ZS-CIR framework that combines Dual-level Compositional Reasoning (DCR) and Triadic Spherical Fusion (TSF). DCR generates fine- and coarse-grained descriptions from the reference image and modification text, capturing complementary target-side semantics across different granularities. To preserve the original image-text query information, TSF constructs a composed-query anchor by spherically interpolating the reference image feature and modification text feature, and fuses it with the fine- and coarse-grained representations using a weighted Karcher mean on the unit hypersphere. The resulting final query representation balances detailed visual evidence, high-level semantic abstraction, and direct preservation of the original composed query. Extensive experiments on CIRCO, CIRR, and Fashion-IQ demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练零样本组合图像检索框架 DCR-TSF：用双层级组合推理生成细粒度与粗粒度目标描述，再以球面插值构造组合查询锚点，并在单位超球面上用加权 Karcher 均值把三路表示融合成最终查询表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多粒度描述 + 锚点」在超球面上的加权融合，可能为 LVR 中如何同时保留直接视觉证据与高层抽象、缓解生成描述导致的信息坍缩提供可核查的表示融合线索，但属检索任务，需人工判断迁移性。
